1-source-1.title: Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 December 2022 on digital operational resilience for the financial sector (DORA)
1-source-1.applicability: All financial entities as defined in Article 2 (credit institutions, payment institutions, account information service providers, electronic money institutions, investment firms, insurance undertakings, etc.)

passages.text: financial entities need to have comprehensive capabilities to enable a strong and effective ICT risk management, as well as specific mechanisms and policies for handling all ICT-related incidents and for reporting major ICT-related incidents. Likewise, financial entities should have policies in place for the testing of ICT systems, controls and processes, as well as for managing ICT third-party risk.

1-source-2.title: EBA Regulatory Technical Standards on ICT Risk Management Framework and Simplified ICT Risk Management
1-source-2.applicability: Supervisory guidance for financial entities implementing DORA Article 6 requirements

passages.text: The Regulatory Technical Standards on ICT risk management framework identify further elements related to ICT risk management with a view to harmonise tools, methods, processes and policies. These elements are complementary to those identified in DORA.

concerns.description: Documented ICT risk management framework covering comprehensive capabilities, incident handling mechanisms, and policies for ICT systems testing and third-party risk management
Harmonized tools, methods, processes and policies for ICT risk management framework implementation
